designationHistory.indexText: Established Oct. 31, 1945, by the Migratory Bird Conservation Commission; the first 11,275-acre tract was acquired March 29, 1946.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

review.note: FWS page says 1946 (first land acquired March 29, 1946). FR and CCP say the Commission formally established the refuge Oct. 31, 1945.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Laguna Atascosa National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1946 to provide habitat for wintering waterfowl and other migratory birds, principally redhead ducks.
